title: 11 Best Herbal Creams For Jaw Lock
intro: Herbal creams for jaw lock are topical treatments containing natural ingredients derived from plants, designed to alleviate the pain and discomfort associated with temporomandibular joint (TMJ) disorders, commonly known as jaw lock. These creams offer a range of benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and improving joint mobility. Examples of herbal creams used to treat jaw lock include arnica and capsaicin creams, which reduce inflammation and numb the pain, as well as creams containing feverfew, ginger, and turmeric, which have anti-inflammatory properties and antioxidant effects. Other herbal creams, such as those containing peppermint, eucalyptus, and wintergreen, can help relax the muscles and improve blood flow, further alleviating the symptoms of jaw lock.
